title: Pick 199 to a $375 Million Mic
description:
198 players were picked before him. Then he got a reported 375 million dollars to talk.

Sources:
- Wikipedia: Tom Brady: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tom_Brady

From Wikipedia (Tom Brady): picked 199th overall by the Patriots in the sixth round of the 2000 NFL draft, the seventh quarterback taken; seven Super Bowl wins in ten appearances, both records; oldest Super Bowl MVP at 43; May 2022, Fox Sports announced he would be its lead NFL color commentator, a deal that reportedly pays $375 million over 10 years, the most for any sports commentator. Not financial advice.

#shorts #tombrady #nfl #howtheymakemoney
loop: So next time you get picked last, remember:
cta: Brady or Mahomes? Comment your pick.

scenes.narration: 198 players were picked before him. Now he's paid 375 million to talk.

Then he won seven Super Bowls. More than any player ever.
His last Super Bowl MVP? At age 43. The oldest ever.
Then he retired. And TV reportedly paid 375 million dollars. Ten years, just to talk.
